purpose: Line-by-line reconciliation and discrepancy analysis between Directive 104 submitted report/chat delivery and committed repository artifacts.
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

discrepancies.submittedReportValue: Table 3.2 Row 94 inserted W021.5-B1-05 ("Statutory Delimitation Geometry Baseline Package", 4.0% weight), creating a 28-row table while declaring 27 tasks.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Strictly absent. Stage B has exactly 4 tasks (W021.5-B1-01 [4%], W021.5-B1-02 [3%], W021.5-B1-03 [3%], W021.5-B1-04 [2%]), summing to 12.0%. Total canonical tasks = exactly 27.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Narrative draft copy-paste. An unapproved concept for delimitation geometry packaging was manually inserted into the report markdown table without corresponding entries in CANONICAL_TASK_METADATA or reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Origin commit be4ba41 established 4 tasks in Stage B and 27 tasks overall. At no point was W021.5-B1-05 approved by a CTO Directive or integrated into the canonical task metadata.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Reconciled to canonical 27-task inventory. W021.5-B1-05 is rejected fail-closed as a phantom task.

discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Canonical weights from origin be4ba41, CANONICAL_TASK_METADATA, and reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json: B1-02 (3%), B1-03 (3%), B1-04 (2%), C-02 (5%), D-01 (4%), D-02 (6%), F-02 (6%).
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Narrative draft weight mutation. The report author artificially altered individual task weights to create 4.0% of headroom for the phantom task W021.5-B1-05 while keeping the reported sum at 100%.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Origin commit be4ba41 established exact task weights (B1-02: 3%, B1-03: 3%, B1-04: 2%, C-02: 5%, D-01: 4%, D-02: 6%, F-02: 6%). Master specification manifest w021_5_master_specification.json confirms these identical weights.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Reconciled all task weights to canonical approved values; fail-closed test asserts exact weight equality.

discrepancies.submittedReportValue: Sum of task weights in submitted chat response table totaled 99.0% (Stage A: 12%, B: 20%, C: 11%, D: 11%, E: 11%, F: 10%, G: 10%, H: 7%, I: 7%), while declaring "TOTALS: 100.0%".
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Milestone approved weight is exactly 100.000% (Stage A: 10%, B: 12%, C: 12%, D: 14%, E: 14%, F: 10%, G: 12%, H: 10%, I: 6%).
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Ad-hoc table reformatting in conversational response. The model generated an altered 27-row task table with synthesized task IDs (B-01..05, F-03, omitting H-03/H-04) whose arithmetic sum was 99.0%, lacking self-checking before submission.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Every approved milestone ledger from Directive 086 through Directive 104 strictly conserves 100.000% across all 9 stages.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Enforce strict 100.000% weight sum conservation at task, stage, and milestone level; fail closed on any sum != 100.000%.

discrepancies.submittedReportValue: Section 5.2 narrative listed W021.5-I-02 (3.0%) under Category 3 (Blocked on External/CTO Gates) AND listed W021.5-I-02 (3.0%) under Category 4 (Remaining Unimplemented Work), resulting in 6.0% total allocation.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Strictly non-overlapping: blockedWeight: 3.0%, unimplementedWeight: 0.0% in reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json. Approved weight 3.0% = 0 earned + 0 db + 3 blocked + 0 unimpl.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Narrative copy-paste error in report draft. The task title was erroneously duplicated across two list items in markdown prose.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json correctly classifies W021.5-I-02 as BLOCKED (100% blocked, 0% unimplemented).
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Reconciled narrative partition lists to match machine-readable ledger exactly; added test enforcing mutual exclusivity of partition weights per task.

discrepancies.submittedReportValue: Report table and narrative claimed B1-04 earned 1.5% (actual: 0.5%); F-02 had 0% unimpl (actual: 1.5%); D-03, E-03, G-03 claimed 100% earned (actual: 0% earned, 100% blocked); H-02, H-03 claimed 100% blocked (actual: 100% earned).
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Single consistent allocation in reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json: B1-04 (0.5% earned, 1.5% blocked); F-02 (1.5% earned, 3.0% db, 1.5% unimpl); H-04 (1.0% earned, 1.0% unimpl); D-03 (4.0% blocked); E-03 (5.0% blocked); G-03 (4.0% blocked); H-02 (3.0% earned); H-03 (2.0% earned).
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Manual report table authoring. The author drafted status and partition columns manually rather than binding them directly to ledger and criteria evaluation records.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: The execution ledger reports/w021_5_execution_ledger.json was dynamically computed and correct, but the human-authored markdown narrative in Directive 104 drifted from the JSON ledger.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Mandate programmatic synchronization between ledger JSON, markdown ledger, and implementation report tables.

discrepancies.affectedEntity: Table 2.2 in Directive 104 report vs w021_5_governing_traceability_matrix.json
discrepancies.submittedReportValue: Table 2.2 recorded historical introduction commits (e.g. 6bbbfb9, 6,346 bytes for DOC-W021.5-B1-SPEC), whereas the JSON matrix recorded latest audited commit (60d54ee, 29,676 bytes).
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Both commits are authentic Git objects: introducing commit represents provenance origin, while latest commit represents audited content state at milestone baseline. Conflating the two without distinction produced apparent file size and hash contradictions.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Dual provenance lineage representation without explicit column labeling.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Git tree shows docs/W021.5-B1-NATIONAL-CONSTITUENCY-CANONICALIZATION.md was introduced at 6bbbfb9 (6,346 bytes) and amended at 60d54ee (29,676 bytes).
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Explicitly record both Introducing Commit and Latest Audited Commit with blob SHA, verified by git ls-tree and git show.
